findings.evidence: FieldOfModuli.lean:122 `instance isGalois_fieldOfModuli [FiniteDimensional ℚ k] (c : IsoClass k) : IsGalois c.fieldOfModuli k`, which holds only in the finite case, while Rigidity.lean now uses `variable [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]` and adds `[IsGalois (mk X).fieldOfModuli k]`.
findings.fix: Generalize the instance `isGalois_fieldOfModuli` (FieldOfModuli.lean:122) from `[FiniteDimensional ℚ k]` to `[Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]` and drop the hypothesis, giving `theorem isDefinedOver_fieldOfModuli : (mk X).IsDefinedOver (mk X).fieldOfModuli` under the section's `[Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]`.
findings.issue: `isDefinedOver_fieldOfModuli` assumes `[IsGalois (mk X).fieldOfModuli k]`, which already follows from `[Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]`: every element of k has a finite orbit under Aut(k/ℚ) (it permutes the roots of the minimal polynomial over ℚ), so k is separable and normal over the fixed field of any subgroup. Callers over `AlgebraicClosure ℚ` or any Galois k must supply this fact by hand.

findings.evidence: grep `fixingSubgroup_fieldOfModuli\b` in TauCeti: only the definition at FieldOfModuli.lean:116 and its docstring entry at line 58; Rigidity.lean switched to `fixingSubgroup_fieldOfModuli_of_isAlgebraic`.
findings.fix: Generalize `fixingSubgroup_fieldOfModuli` in place to `[Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]` (moving it next to `exists_finiteDimensional_isDefinedOver` if imports require), and remove the duplicate `_of_isAlgebraic` name and the finite-only statement.
findings.issue: The new `fixingSubgroup_fieldOfModuli_of_isAlgebraic` has the same statement as the existing `IsoClass.fixingSubgroup_fieldOfModuli` (FieldOfModuli.lean:116) under the weaker `[Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ k]`. The finite-only version is left as a strict special case and has no remaining uses.

summary: The generalization to infinite Galois extensions is mostly at the natural level, but the field-of-moduli layer keeps a finite-only lemma next to its general replacement and adds a Galois hypothesis that is automatic for algebraic k.
